summary: Prefetch CSF scales for prepared hybrid kernels that consume ready expanded scales
compatibility: Hybrid prefill remains disabled by default. Enabling it requires FlashInfer's uses_expanded_nvfp4_scales interface to declare the scales_expanded readiness parameter.
details: Prefetch queries prospective scale readiness for each semantic range in the following layer.
Binding receives readiness only after waiting for the matching prefetch event; compressed consumers remain eligible when expansion is unnecessary.
Scale storage selection does not alter scheduler-based A4 prefill and A16 verification precision.
